labels.name: wave right hand (kinematic)
labels.definition: The right hand shows an observable back-and-forth waving pattern in position or orientation, with alternating sweeps and direction reversals. The wrist, forearm or whole arm may contribute. This describes movement form only; greeting, farewell, refusal or intended recipient are not inferred.
labels.boundary_rule: Start at the first sweep belonging to the observed back-and-forth bout; end at the last sweep before a clear stop or change of movement form. A single unidirectional reach is not this pattern. Choose the primary observed moving part (hand or same-side arm) for one annotation; do not duplicate the same bout merely because both parts participate.

extra.auto_method: No waving detector is implemented in this release. A future rule may use body-relative hand trajectory/orientation and repeated reversals with explicit amplitude, duration and repetition criteria. Current generic arm/hand movement proposals do not classify waving.

extra.auto_method: No arm outward/inward detector is implemented in this release. A future rule needs validated shoulder, upper-arm and torso geometry; current arm activity is not this classification.
extra.description_zh: 所选侧上臂相对躯干向外展开；只靠伸肘使手远离身体不足以证明这一肩部层级运动。

labels.name: move arm inward

labels.name: open hand
labels.definition: The selected hand changes from a more closed or curled configuration toward visibly unfolded digits. This is a shape-change process; it does not by itself prove release of an object.

labels.name: move legs apart
labels.definition: The spatial separation of the legs increases through movement of one or both legs. This coarse bilateral pattern does not establish a front split, middle split, pure hip abduction or contact.
labels.boundary_rule: Use Full Body for the combined bilateral observation, or the primarily moving leg when only that side is being analysed. Mark separation change from onset to cessation. Do not duplicate the same bout on both legs and Full Body; do not include the held configuration.

extra.auto_method: No bilateral leg-separation detector is implemented in this release. A future rule may measure validated body-relative leg separation, but cannot infer a split posture from separation alone.

labels.boundary_rule: Start at the first clear flexion of the selected knee; end when it stops or reverses. Exclude a subsequent held bent or straight position. Use a valid hip-knee-ankle mapping or visible joint movement, not a raw Euler-channel sign or whole-leg displacement.

extra.auto_method: No knee flexion/extension detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires validated joint mapping, an explicit knee-angle convention and amplitude/time criteria. Existing coarse leg movement proposals do not classify the knee movement.

labels.boundary_rule: Start at the first clear extension of the selected knee; end when it stops or reverses. Exclude a subsequent held bent or straight position. Use a valid hip-knee-ankle mapping or visible joint movement, not a raw Euler-channel sign or whole-leg displacement.

labels.name: kick right leg (kinematic)
labels.definition: The right leg or foot makes a distinct projecting swing or thrust. This is a coarser movement pattern that may combine hip and knee motion, not a strictly atomic joint primitive. labels.boundary_rule: Start at the first movement belonging to the distinct projecting bout; end when the thrust and any immediately connected retraction finish. Split separate kicks at a clear pause or new bout. Do not extend the event through a subsequently held leg posture.

extra.auto_method: No kicking detector is implemented in this release. A future kinematic rule needs body-relative leg/foot trajectory and validated joint motion; coarse leg activity is not a kicking classification and cannot establish an object strike.
